v0.1.1.description:
A match-3 puzzle game that is also an Archipelago world.

**Play it at <https://gems.browsergam.ing/>.**

## What is in this release

- **`twiddlygems.apworld`** goes in your Archipelago installation's
  `custom_worlds/` directory.
- **`twiddlygems.yaml`** is the player template, with every setting
  documented in place.

Both were built from this tag and tested together: the yaml is
generated from the `.apworld` beside it, so the versions in its
header are the ones this world was packaged with.

## Connecting

Open <https://gems.browsergam.ing/>, choose Archipelago on the title
screen, and give it the server, port and slot name. The run is kept
on the server rather than in the browser, so you can pick it up on
another device.
